name: Organic Oat Cold Brew Latte
caffeineNote: Brand states 52–58 mg per 8 oz can
summary: USDA Organic cold brew on oat milk from the Los Angeles roaster, vegan and made without seed oils. Date paste does the sweetening, so its 5 g of sugar carries 0 g added, and at 50 calories per 8 oz can it is the lightest can on record here. Brand-stated 52–58 mg of caffeine.
